mails.subject: Proposition de partenariat : externalisation de votre gestion commerciale
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Optimia Conseil, cabinet spécialisé dans l'externalisation commerciale, a l'honneur de vous soumettre une proposition de collaboration.
Nous mettons à la disposition des structures telles que la vôtre une équipe dédiée à la prospection et à la qualification de contacts.
Notre offre forfaitaire débute à 1 450 EUR par mois, sans engagement de durée.
Nous serions heureux de vous présenter nos références lors d'un entretien téléphonique de vingt minutes.
Dans l'attente de votre retour, nous vous prions d'agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Laurent Berthier
Directeur du développement, Optimia Conseil
mails.justification: Cold outsourcing sales proposal from an unknown consultancy, formal but with no prior relationship.

mails.subject: Rank higher in Copenhagen: 600 EUR deal
mails.body:
Hi,

I am Tom from SerpBooster. I checked your website and it is not on the first page of Google for coworking in Copenhagen.
We can fix that. For a one time fee of 600 EUR we optimise your pages and publish 15 backlinks from partner blogs.
The offer is valid until the end of the month and we only take 5 new clients per quarter.
Reply to this email with the word YES and I will send the invoice and start work right away.

Tom Wexley
SerpBooster Agency
mails.justification: Unsolicited SEO and backlink package with a price, from a stranger.

mails.subject: Re: Votre facture FA-2026-0932 en attente
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Pour éviter des pénalités de retard et la suspension de vos services, merci de vous connecter à votre espace client afin de valider le paiement :
http://espace-client.gestion-factures-securite.example/connexion

mails.subject: Private opportunity, very limited
mails.body:
Dear Sir,

I hope this finds you well. I work with a private investment group that has opened access to a crypto trading program with guaranteed returns of 8 percent weekly.
Our members double their money in about 10 weeks. No experience is required, our traders do everything.
The minimum deposit is 500 EUR and it can be withdrawn at any time, we promise.
Because places are limited I need your answer before Monday. Reply with your phone number and I will call you.

Sincerely,
Richard Hale
Senior Partner, Meridian Wealth Desk
mails.justification: Investment scam promising guaranteed returns, sent by a stranger to a generic inbox.

mails.subject: NOTICE: Domain registration renewal invoice 2026/10
mails.body:
Dear Domain Holder,

This is a formal notice regarding the registration of your domain name, issued by the Nordic Digital Registry Administration.

Our records indicate that the annual renewal fee for your domain is due. Failure to complete the renewal within seven (7) days will result in the domain being released to the public registry and your website and email services will be interrupted.

Invoice reference: NDR-2026-884201
Amount due: 189,00 EUR (including administration fee)
Payment deadline: 19 October 2026

To avoid interruption, you are required to verify your account and settle the invoice via our secure portal:
http://portal.nordic-digital-registry.example/renew

You will be asked to enter your domain control password and your payment card details to confirm the renewal.

Please note that this notice is not issued by your current hosting provider. Late renewals are subject to a reactivation surcharge of 95,00 EUR.

Yours faithfully,

Department of Domain Renewals
Nordic Digital Registry Administration
This message is intended for the domain holder only.
mails.justification: Phishing posing as a formal domain renewal invoice, asking for passwords and card details through a suspicious link.

mails.subject: Arv efter afdød: 2.450.000 DKK venter på dig
mails.body:
Kære modtager

Jeg er advokat og repræsenterer en afdød kunde med samme efternavn som din virksomhed. Han efterlod 2.450.000 DKK uden kendte arvinger.

Du kan stå som arving, og du får 35 procent af beløbet. Resten dækker mine omkostninger.
For at starte skal du blot sende dit fulde navn, adresse og kontonummer, samt betale et sagsgebyr på 1.200 DKK.
Sagen er fortrolig, så tal ikke med andre om den.

Venlig hilsen
Henrik Dalgaard
Advokat
mails.justification: Inheritance scam asking for personal data and an upfront fee, from a stranger.
